articles.summary: Company repurchased approximately 822,000 shares for total consideration of $32.7 million in Q1 2025; Company has repurchased approximately 6.8% of outstanding shares since December 2024 Generated $0.51 of net income per share in Fiscal Q1 ‘25 Reported gross profit of $14.3 million for Fiscal Q1
articles.title: REX American Resources Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2025 Net Income Per Share Attributable to REX Common Shareholders of $0.51
